Auto-discovery idea: Ephb2 expression links ATRX to LINE1-marked chromatin proximity¶

Rationale¶

Builds on graph directions cross_modal_bridge-8f63667fa8 and coverage_gap-d3e9af58f0 by using Ephb2, an under-tested linked RNA gene, with ATRX, an under-tested IF marker, while avoiding prior Pcp2/Calb1/Aldoc/RNAPII signatures.

  • Hypothesis: Ephb2 expression is associated with altered proximity between ATRX-enriched chromatin sites and LINE1-marked repeat-rich regions.
  • Data used: 3D coordinates, spot cell IDs, ATRX and LINE1 IF/RNA-repeat tracks, linked Ephb2 expression, and cell type labels for robustness checks.
  • Analysis sketch: in each cell, find ATRX-high spots and compute their nearest 3D distance to LINE1-high spots in the same cell; summarize by the median and correlate with Ephb2 expression.
  • Expected result: Ephb2-high cells show shorter ATRX-to-LINE1 distances if ATRX-associated heterochromatin/repeat organization is strengthened in that RNA state.
  • Validation: check required fields and cell alignment, enforce cell and spot thresholds, report finite outputs and a permutation p-value, rerun deterministically, bound runtime, and compare against shuffled LINE1-high labels.

Exploration¶

The code agent can freely add cells below this point.

Critique and analysis plan¶

This is a very small linked subset (9 cells), so the test should be treated as an exploratory audit rather than biological validation. I will operationalize the idea exactly at the per-cell level: within each cell, label ATRX-high and LINE1-high spots by upper-quartile track values, compute the median nearest-neighbor 3D distance from ATRX-high spots to LINE1-high spots, and test whether this distance has a negative Spearman association with linked Ephb2 expression. The primary p-value will use a deterministic label-permutation test (bounded to 500 permutations); a within-cell shuffled LINE1-high control will be reported as a negative-control distance summary, not as a replacement for the primary hypothesis test.

# Main exploration: Ephb2 expression vs ATRX-high to LINE1-high 3D proximity.
import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLBACKEND', 'Agg')
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg', force=True)
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from IPython.display import Image, display

start_time = time.time()
rng = np.random.default_rng(94124)
N_PERM = 500
MIN_HIGH_SPOTS = 20
ROOT = Path('/Users/weizexu/Projects/U-Chrom')
REL_RESULT_PATH = Path('tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/iterative_2x10_litsearch_rounds/iteration_01/ephb2-expression-links-atrx-to-line1-marked-chro-d83a94124b_result.csv')
REL_FIG_PATH = Path('tmp/takei_auto_discovery_doc/iterative_2x10_litsearch_rounds/iteration_01/ephb2-expression-links-atrx-to-line1-marked-chro-d83a94124b_statistical_summary.png')
RESULT_PATH = ROOT / REL_RESULT_PATH
FIG_PATH = ROOT / REL_FIG_PATH
RESULT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Extract aligned per-cell Ephb2 expression.
cell_ids = list(map(str, cdata.cells.index))
adata_ids = list(map(str, adata.obs_names))
cell_axis_aligned = cell_ids == adata_ids
if 'Ephb2' not in list(adata.var_names):
    raise KeyError('Ephb2 not found in linked_adata.var_names')
ephb2_X = adata[:, ['Ephb2']].X
ephb2_expr = np.asarray(ephb2_X.toarray()).ravel() if hasattr(ephb2_X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(ephb2_X).ravel()
expr_by_cell = dict(zip(cell_ids, ephb2_expr.astype(float)))

spots = cdata.spots.copy()
spots['_row'] = np.arange(len(spots))
spots['cell_id'] = spots['cell_id'].astype(str)
coords = np.asarray(cdata.coords, dtype=float)
atrx = np.asarray(cdata.tracks['ATRX'], dtype=float)
line1 = np.asarray(cdata.tracks['LINE1'], dtype=float)
cell_type_by_cell = cdata.cells['cell_type'].astype(str).to_dict()


def median_atrx_to_line1_for_cell(cell_id, shuffled_line1=False, local_rng=None):
    idx = spots.index[spots['cell_id'].values == cell_id].to_numpy()
    if idx.size == 0:
        return np.nan, 0, 0, int(idx.size), np.nan, np.nan
    finite = np.isfinite(coords[idx]).all(axis=1) & np.isfinite(atrx[idx]) & np.isfinite(line1[idx])
    idx = idx[finite]
    if idx.size == 0:
        return np.nan, 0, 0, 0, np.nan, np.nan
    atrx_thr = np.nanquantile(atrx[idx], 0.75)
    line1_thr = np.nanquantile(line1[idx], 0.75)
    atrx_idx = idx[atrx[idx] >= atrx_thr]
    observed_line1_idx = idx[line1[idx] >= line1_thr]
    if shuffled_line1:
        if local_rng is None:
            local_rng = rng
        n_line = len(observed_line1_idx)
        # Within-cell negative control: place the same number of LINE1-high labels on random finite spots.
        line1_idx = local_rng.choice(idx, size=n_line, replace=False) if n_line <= len(idx) else observed_line1_idx
    else:
        line1_idx = observed_line1_idx
    if len(atrx_idx) < MIN_HIGH_SPOTS or len(line1_idx) < MIN_HIGH_SPOTS:
        return np.nan, int(len(atrx_idx)), int(len(line1_idx)), int(idx.size), float(atrx_thr), float(line1_thr)
    tree = cKDTree(coords[line1_idx])
    dists, _ = tree.query(coords[atrx_idx], k=1, workers=1)
    return float(np.nanmedian(dists)), int(len(atrx_idx)), int(len(line1_idx)), int(idx.size), float(atrx_thr), float(line1_thr)

rows = []
for cell_id in cell_ids:
    med_dist, n_atrx, n_line1, n_spots, atrx_thr, line1_thr = median_atrx_to_line1_for_cell(cell_id, shuffled_line1=False)
    ctrl_dist, _, ctrl_n_line1, _, _, _ = median_atrx_to_line1_for_cell(cell_id, shuffled_line1=True, local_rng=rng)
    rows.append({
        'cell_id': cell_id,
        'cell_type': cell_type_by_cell.get(cell_id, 'unknown'),
        'Ephb2_expression': float(expr_by_cell[cell_id]),
        'median_atrx_to_line1_um': med_dist,
        'negative_control_median_atrx_to_shuffled_line1_um': ctrl_dist,
        'control_minus_observed_um': float(ctrl_dist - med_dist) if np.isfinite(ctrl_dist) and np.isfinite(med_dist) else np.nan,
        'n_finite_spots': n_spots,
        'n_ATRX_high_spots': n_atrx,
        'n_LINE1_high_spots': n_line1,
        'ATRX_q75_threshold': atrx_thr,
        'LINE1_q75_threshold': line1_thr,
    })

per_cell = pd.DataFrame(rows)
eligible = per_cell[np.isfinite(per_cell['Ephb2_expression']) & np.isfinite(per_cell['median_atrx_to_line1_um'])].copy()
n_eligible = int(len(eligible))

null_hypothesis = 'Per-cell Ephb2 expression is exchangeable with respect to median ATRX-high to LINE1-high nearest-neighbor 3D distance; Spearman rho is not more negative than expected by chance.'
alternative_hypothesis = 'Higher per-cell Ephb2 expression is associated with shorter ATRX-high to LINE1-high nearest-neighbor 3D distance, giving a negative Spearman rho.'
test_method = f'one-sided Spearman label-permutation test ({N_PERM} deterministic permutations; alternative rho < 0)'

if n_eligible >= 6 and eligible['Ephb2_expression'].nunique() > 1 and eligible['median_atrx_to_line1_um'].nunique() > 1:
    observed_rho = float(spearmanr(eligible['Ephb2_expression'], eligible['median_atrx_to_line1_um']).statistic)
    null_rhos = np.empty(N_PERM, dtype=float)
    expr_values = eligible['Ephb2_expression'].to_numpy(copy=True)
    dist_values = eligible['median_atrx_to_line1_um'].to_numpy(copy=True)
    for i in range(N_PERM):
        perm_expr = rng.permutation(expr_values)
        null_rhos[i] = float(spearmanr(perm_expr, dist_values).statistic)
    p_value = float((1 + np.sum(null_rhos <= observed_rho)) / (N_PERM + 1))
    hypothesis_test_status = 'pass'
else:
    observed_rho = float(spearmanr(eligible['Ephb2_expression'], eligible['median_atrx_to_line1_um']).statistic) if n_eligible >= 2 else 0.0
    if not np.isfinite(observed_rho):
        observed_rho = 0.0
    null_rhos = np.array([0.0])
    p_value = 1.0
    hypothesis_test_status = 'insufficient_data'

control_delta_median = float(np.nanmedian(eligible['control_minus_observed_um'])) if n_eligible else np.nan
runtime_seconds = float(time.time() - start_time)

result_table = per_cell.copy()
result_table['observed_statistic'] = observed_rho
result_table['effect_size'] = observed_rho
result_table['p_value'] = p_value
result_table['test_method'] = test_method
result_table['hypothesis_test_status'] = hypothesis_test_status
result_table.to_csv(RESULT_PATH, index=False)

analysis_summary = {
    'idea_id': IDEA.idea_id,
    'n_selected_cells': n_eligible,
    'n_rows': int(len(result_table)),
    'parameter_value': observed_rho,
    'observed_statistic': observed_rho,
    'effect_size': observed_rho,
    'p_value': p_value,
    'test_method': test_method,
    'null_hypothesis': null_hypothesis,
    'alternative_hypothesis': alternative_hypothesis,
    'hypothesis_test_status': hypothesis_test_status,
    'expected_direction': 'negative Spearman rho: higher Ephb2, shorter ATRX-to-LINE1 distance',
    'cell_axis_alignment_between_cells_index_and_linked_adata_obs_names': bool(cell_axis_aligned),
    'minimum_high_spots_per_marker': MIN_HIGH_SPOTS,
    'n_permutations': N_PERM,
    'negative_control': 'within-cell shuffled LINE1-high labels preserving the number of LINE1-high spots per cell',
    'negative_control_median_control_minus_observed_um': control_delta_median,
    'runtime_seconds': runtime_seconds,
    'result_path': str(REL_RESULT_PATH),
    'figure_path': str(REL_FIG_PATH),
    'notes': [
        'Small n=9 subset; p-value is an exploratory randomization audit, not biological proof.',
        'Distances are in micrometers from ChromData coords xyz_unit=um.',
    ],
}

# Statistical figure: observed cell-level association and permutation null distribution.
plt.close('all')
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.2), facecolor='white')
ax = axes[0]
for ctype, grp in eligible.groupby('cell_type'):
    ax.scatter(grp['Ephb2_expression'], grp['median_atrx_to_line1_um'], s=58, label=f'{ctype} (n={len(grp)})', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
if n_eligible >= 2:
    x = eligible['Ephb2_expression'].to_numpy(float)
    y = eligible['median_atrx_to_line1_um'].to_numpy(float)
    if np.unique(x).size > 1:
        coef = np.polyfit(x, y, deg=1)
        xx = np.linspace(np.nanmin(x), np.nanmax(x), 100)
        ax.plot(xx, np.polyval(coef, xx), color='black', lw=1.4, label='linear guide')
ax.set_xlabel('Linked Ephb2 expression (adata X units)')
ax.set_ylabel('Median nearest ATRX-high to LINE1-high distance (um)')
ax.set_title('Per-cell association')
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)

ax = axes[1]
ax.hist(null_rhos, bins=24, color='#bdbdbd', edgecolor='white', label='permuted Ephb2 labels')
ax.axvline(observed_rho, color='#b2182b', lw=2.2, label=f'observed rho={observed_rho:.3f}')
ax.axvline(np.nanmedian(null_rhos), color='black', lw=1.2, ls='--', label=f'null median={np.nanmedian(null_rhos):.3f}')
ax.set_xlabel('Spearman rho under null')
ax.set_ylabel('Permutation count')
ax.set_title('Hypothesis-test evidence')
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
ax.text(0.02, 0.98, f'p={p_value:.3f}\neffect size=rho={observed_rho:.3f}\nn={n_eligible} cells\n{N_PERM} permutations', transform=ax.transAxes, ha='left', va='top', fontsize=9, bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', edgecolor='0.75'))
fig.suptitle('Ephb2 expression vs ATRX-to-LINE1 chromatin proximity', fontsize=12)
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.94])
fig.savefig(FIG_PATH, dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')

    return [key for key in checks if key == prefix or key.startswith(prefix + ':')]

def _set_check(prefix, value):
    keys = _check_keys(prefix)
    if not keys:
        checks[prefix] = value
        return
    for key in keys:
        checks[key] = value

def _check_status(prefix):
    values = [checks[key] for key in _check_keys(prefix)]
    if not values:

    if 'fail' in values:

    if all(value == 'pass' for value in values):

    return values[0]

Final interpretation¶

Hypothesis. Ephb2 expression marks cells in which ATRX-enriched chromatin is more closely spatially associated with LINE1-marked repeat-rich chromatin.

Exploration. The notebook operationalized the idea as Spearman correlation coefficient between per-cell Ephb2 expression and per-cell median nearest-neighbor 3D distance from ATRX-high spots to LINE1-high spots. using modalities chromatin_tracing, if_tracks, rna_expression, cell_metadata in cell type(s) Granule, Bergmann, Purkinje. Required data fields checked: coords, spots.cell_id, tracks.ATRX, tracks.LINE1, linked_adata.X, linked_adata.var.Ephb2, linked_adata.obs_names, cells.cell_type.

Statistical evidence. U-Chrom runner status: Notebook verified. Test: one-sided Spearman label-permutation test (500 deterministic permutations; alternative rho < 0). Observed statistic: 0.211; effect size: 0.211; parameter value: 0.211; p-value: 0.7365.

Conclusion. Not supported (Opposite direction). The observed effect points opposite to the expected direction and does not provide statistical support in this subset.

What verification means. Notebook verified means the run passed schema/data checks, produced finite numeric output, and included an explicit p-value/effect-size hypothesis test. It does not mean the biological hypothesis is automatically correct.

Checks passed. required_fields_exist, statistical_hypothesis_test.

Main caveat. Small n=9 subset; p-value is an exploratory randomization audit, not biological proof.
